house.description: Nonemergency medical transportation providers required to operate vehicles equipped with a global positions system and rear-facing camera, compile information for each trip, and retain recordings for two years.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Human Services Finance and Policy

additions: (m) A vehicle operated by a nonemergency medical transportation provider must be equipped with a global positioning system capable of tracking the route taken by the vehicle and a rear-facing camera capable of recording a sufficient area of the passenger compartment to identify the recipient of the service and the date and time when the recording was made.
(c) In addition to the requirements under paragraph (a), a nonemergency medical transportation provider must compile transportation trip records that include:
(1) global positioning system data showing the origin and destination of each trip; and
(2) a recording of the passenger compartment of the vehicle taken from a rear-facing camera that shows the recipient of the service and the date and time when the recording was made.
, except that the documentation requirements in paragraph (c) do not apply retroactively
(e) Notwithstanding any other law or rule to the contrary, recordings of the passenger compartment of a vehicle must be retained for two years.
